content_of_post_to_answer: Does being super smart make life harder because your brain is always thinking about everything around you?
answer: Being highly intelligent can make life harder, but not necessarily because you think more. It is often because you notice more possibilities, contradictions, consequences, and problems than you can realistically do anything about. The real burden isn't intelligence itself; it's the inability to disengage from what your mind keeps noticing. Intelligence helps you understand complexity, but it doesn't automatically teach you which complexities deserve your attention. Sometimes, peace comes from recognizing that not everything you can think about needs to be thought through.
